title: pm-daily-scratchpad-2026-04-07
content:
Morning notes (7 Apr 2026)

Top priorities
- Finalize PRD edits for "multi-model routing": tighten success metrics, add rollback criteria, clarify compatibility matrix for quantized variants. Need Aisha sign-off by EOD.
- Launch checklist for Dedicated beta: coordinate canary on us-east-1 node pool, validate perf targets (p95 < 120ms for small-batch), confirm telemetry retention for billing.

Meetings
- 9:00 sync w/ infra: infra to provide capacity estimate for Dedicated canary (Ravi). Ask: how many gpus reserved for canary? expected warm-up time?
- 10:30 design review w/ UX: review rollout UI for model pinning + canary toggle. Action: Marta to extract copy and mockups.
- 14:00 rollout plan w/ SRE + Console: run through failure scenarios + automated fallback to hosted-compat variant. Create runbook stub.

PRD edits (quick checklist)
- Add clear rollout stages: dev build -> internal canary -> closed beta -> open beta -> GA.
- Metrics: latency (p50/p95), throughput (tokens/sec), error rate, cost-per-token. Add baseline numbers from benchmark deck.
- Add acceptance tests: smoke generation, kv-cache correctness, quantized-model parity on small prompts.
- Rollback criteria: >2x error rate or p95 > 2x baseline for 10m.

Action items (today)
- [ ] Share updated PRD draft with Aisha + SRE by noon (Jordan)
- [ ] Create Jira epic and link acceptance tests (RED-4321) (Jordan)
- [ ] Follow up w/ infra on capacity numbers + cost estimate (Ravi)
- [ ] Request Console retention change for canary telemetry (Marta)
- [ ] Draft customer-facing one-pager for Dedicated beta signup (short)

Blockers / open questions
- Licensing for some third-party benchmark tool — legal check needed (FYI to legal).
- Does Dedicated beta require special KMS setup for customers? If so, add to onboarding checklist.

Notes from yesterday
- Got perf numbers from bench run: small-batch p95 95ms (A100, fp16), medium-batch p95 210ms. Need to decide target SLOs for canary.
- GitHub PR #789 landed core routing changes but missing monitoring hooks. Need to add telemetry events: route_chosen, fallback_triggered, model_variant_id.

Misc scratch / quick reminders
- Slack threads: #prod-hosted-api, thread "canary-capacity" — summarize there after infra sync.
- Add short eval prompt set for QA to prevent hallucination regressions. Put prompts in RED-4321 subtask.
- Reminder: town hall next week, prepare 2-slide summary (status + ask).

End-of-day goals
- PRD in review with collaborators + created Jira epic + initial canary runbook stub.

Random thoughts / brainstorming (rough)
- Could we add an opt-in "economy routing" tier that uses cheaper quantized variants with best-effort latency? Worth a backlog spike.

---
Notes to self: keep PRD readable for eng + sales. Avoid too much infra detail in top-level doc; link deeper spec for infra.
